ModMetaData.name: RimWard – Hospital for Profit (Anesthesia Not Included)
ModMetaData.author: juliusberger00
ModMetaData.description:
Run a hospital for strangers. Lay down medical beds and injured or sick people from other factions arrive by drop pod; your doctors treat them and they pay in silver when they leave.
- Wounds, diseases and operations your colony can actually do; a letter asks first before an operation uses your stock. - One itemised invoice: the Bill column, the offer letter and the silver paid always match. - Nobody gets stuck: dismissed patients leave, impossible operations end with a letter, a maximum stay. - Fair malpractice: goodwill is lost only for deaths that are your fault. - Hospital tab with a checklist and one-click fixes; policies per save; areas, presets and blacklists in the JB Framework settings. Sensible defaults, no settings needed. - Optional: Hospital Beds Gen 2, Hearth & Harbor, Luciferium Overhaul, Combat Extended, all DLCs. English and German. Multiplayer: not supported.
Adding it mid-game works. To remove it, press "Prepare for removal" (Mod settings, RimWard, Patient intake) and save: the save then loads without RimWard with no error. Without preparing, the first load shows a red error for each patient on the map and each open hospital letter; the colony plays on.
Built and tested on RimWorld 1.7. The 1.6 build is best effort and untested.
Requires Harmony and JB Framework. Replaces Hospital and Hospital Fix And Tweak. GPL-3.0 fork of Adamas's Hospital and assssssqwww's Hospital Fix And Tweak; source: https://github.com/jb-rimworld/rimward. Built with the help of Claude Code.
